public_holidays: 2027-10-05 (Tuesday): Criação do Estado de Roraima (data magna), state holiday set by the state constitution (art. 9)
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here.

laws.rule: Roraima state Lei 1.484/2021 bans handling, using, burning and letting off loud-bang fireworks and noisy pyrotechnic devices across the state, on public and private land. Only fireworks with visual effects or low-intensity noise are allowed. Fine R$2,000 (about A$524 (A$1 = R$3.8138, Banco Central do Brasil PTAX, 30 Oct 2026)), doubled for a repeat. The legislature itself has said enforcement is a challenge.
laws.heading: Lei 1.484/2021

laws.rule: Roraima state Lei 745/2009 bans smoking cigarettes and any other smoking product in public places and in shared spaces, public or private, as reported by the state legislature. Lei 186/1998 bans selling tobacco products to anyone under 18.
